finalists.label: Neurosarcoidosis
finalists.why: It has the most specific findings including elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and C-reactive protein level, extensive white matter changes, and thick exudate in subarachnoid space.

finalists.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis
finalists.why: It is supported by the high titer of cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody and has no findings against it.

finalists.label: Neurosyphilis
finalists.why: It is supported by bilateral upgoing plantars and extensive white matter changes, and has no findings against it.
